card.name: Partway through long compound words
card.fires_on: The middle or final piece of a long, multi-part word, such as peritone|al, pamph|lets, dip|stick, isocyan|urate, or Fumar|ate. It also fires on a noun that completes a chemical or product name, such as sulfate or capsules.

modes.label: Inside long split words
modes.description: A word is broken into pieces and the marked piece sits in the middle or at the end.

modes.label: Closing a chemical or product name
modes.description: The marked word finishes a drug, salt or product name.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It activates when a long or unusual word is split up and the model is partway through, or just finishing, that word.
